div.head: Grið 19
div.ab: Hælnesgrið 7 hadgrið healde man mid rihte æfre swyþe georne 7 Godes lagum fylge 7 lareowum hlyste, swa þærto gebyrige.
Hælnesgrið and hadgrið healde man mid rihte æfre swyþe georne, and Godes lagum fylge and lareowum hlyste, swa þærto gebyrige.

The security and ecclesiastical privileges of the sanctuary are always to be observed most assiduously according to the law, and God’s laws are to be followed and teachers are to be heeded, as is appropriate to them.
Den Sonderfrieden des Heiligthums und den des Klerus halte man stets nach Recht höchst willig und folge den kirchlichen Gesetzen und lausche den [geistlichen] Lehrern, wie jenen zukommt.

Let the special peace of the sanctuary and that of the clergy always be kept lawfully and most willingly, and let one follow the laws of the Church and listen to the [spiritual] teachers, as befits them.
div.note: T: corrected against Rabin, DOML 66 (2020), p. 26 (before: ‘Hælnesgrið and hadgrið healde man mid rihte æfre swyþe georne, and Godes lagum fylge 7 lareowum hlyste, swa þærto gebyrige.’)
security and ecclesiastical privileges: Both hælnesgrið and hadgrið are hapax legomena.
